title: feature-profile.json
description: Which PostgreSQL features and dependencies are kept or excluded, and why. Optional ranges narrow an entry to a version span; no entry means it applies to every version.

configureFlag.description: The flag actually passed to configure for this decision; omit when the default already gives the wanted result.

upstreamOptions.description: Upstream configure options this entry is about; each must exist in that release's configure --help.

sizeImpact.description: Measured effect on size, or the literal 'pending measurement (<item>)'.
